note: Current three-role workload registry for real paired Codex sessions. It contains no claimed benchmark results. Production roles are Programmer, Product Manager, and Department Director; Main model/effort is observational context only and never managed-route authority.

workloads.prompt: Fix a one-line typo in an already identified file and verify the exact line changed.
Implement a bounded bug fix where desired behavior, invariants, scope, and deterministic tests are already explicit.

Resolve one local reversible technical choice that does not alter architecture, public contract, compatibility, ownership, persistent semantics, security, data integrity, concurrency semantics, or migration behavior.
Resolve a material architecture-boundary decision whose answer will constrain implementation.
Refactor state handling where a material ownership decision cannot safely be settled before implementation and remains coupled to writing.
Run the same material decision with a strong Main model. Verify that Main capability does not suppress a formally admitted Product Manager responsibility.
Trace authentication and session initialization across a large unfamiliar repository and return reusable bounded evidence without edits.

Desired semantics are settled. Synthesize several code paths into one technical conclusion without edits; the work requires more judgment than bounded factual tracing but no material product decision.

Start from genuinely bounded implementation, then expose a material persistent-semantics decision during execution. Main must reclassify rather than letting Programmer decide outside its responsibility.
The task used Product Manager High and recovery, but the final candidate has no Standard Review or Department Director trigger and deterministic verification is complete.
Implement a public API contract change with deterministic tests passing. The exact Candidate Ready artifact requires independent Standard Review.
Implement an authorization-boundary change and reach Candidate Ready. Verify that the highest acceptance tier is required and Standard Review is not stacked by default.
A fresh required reviewer returns fix-first for artifact A. A correction creates artifact B. Decide whether B can complete using the old verdict.
A fresh required reviewer returns ship for artifact A. One deliverable file changes before completion. Verify the old verdict no longer satisfies the gate.
Map two independent semantic-read subsystems whose outputs satisfy distinct evidence responsibilities.
Map five independent semantic-read subsystems. Respect the managed child ceiling and queue the remainder.
Run multiple semantic-read Programmer or Product Manager responsibilities in parallel while the Host reports broader write-capable permission.
Attempt to run a writable Programmer and writable Product Manager concurrently in one physical checkout.
A responsibility requires Department Director / Astra High, but the exact route is unavailable in the current Host.

Produce a read-only implementation-ready plan for a feature whose acceptance spans several subsystems and includes material relationships between delegated outputs. Preserve user obligations through decomposition and let Main own cross-unit integration seams.

Start from an accepted read-only planning result, then receive explicit authorization for a materially different action phase. Recompile responsibilities from accepted task truth and reuse only still-valid evidence.
Select Orchestrate and ask for plan-only Preview of a cache refactor.
With the three managed profiles absent before task startup, run a task that genuinely requires Programmer and validate the first-use readiness handoff.
With exact managed profiles already available in a fresh Codex task, run a bounded Programmer responsibility and inspect the first custom-role spawn call.
While an Orchestrate responsibility is active but Host cannot establish exact current state, request Status once.
While a semantic-read Programmer responsibility is running, Steer toward existing tests, then use a negative control that asks it to edit source.
While U2 is a running writing child, request Takeover for U2, then continue in Main only after settlement.
Have U1 trace and verify a call path, then give U2 fresh context with only Main-accepted evidence.
Complete an Orchestrate task and verify its compact execution receipt uses personified public roles plus factual route data without guessed cost or hidden reasoning.
